escalation.situation: Rover-1 suffered a hardware failure at t=85. Payload carriers left: Cargo-1. 3 survivors (S2, S3, S6) await aid in sector C under a storm cell. Forecast 0% is below the 60% threshold.

options.title: Hold the current plan
options.detail: Keep every safety limit; drones stay out of hazards until conditions change.

options.title: Fly Cargo-1 through the storm now
options.detail: Lifts the storm-risk ceiling for Cargo-1. Risk of losing the airframe (4% per tick inside the cell).

options.title: Relax the battery-reserve invariant
options.detail: Allow sorties that end without the 15% return reserve. More reach, risk of aborted sorties.

log.text: Operator approved: option A — Hold the current plan (P(success) 0%)
